title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Hildegard stellar reach and selective wind contact as one whole diagram account
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. New source input: complete Liber divinorum operum I.2 §I (electronic Latin with columns 751A–755A) and the institutionally dated thirteenth-century Lucca MS1942 f9r full photograph. Sixteen principal stars and twelve wind-head occurrences are different entity classes, with eight stellar rays reaching thin air and eight only black fire; the Sun touches leopard/lion/wolf but explicitly not bear. This provides a particular alternative to treating every f69r item as a direction/wind name. No Voynich word, item owner or orientation is assigned. Generic register dependency already belongs to IDEA000661; generic agent/medium and macrocosm correspondence to IDEA000535/536. The new raw content is this complete source account and its asymmetric, typed terminals, including the full moral qualification in §XXXV. Report: research_registry/proposals/laufenberg_f85r2_20260926/source_supply_20260929/P_SOURCE_REVIEW.md.

design.mechanism: A whole cosmographic account describes interacting stellar emitters and wind agents using stable reach/contact relations with distinct endpoint types and an explicit selective exception. It does not require the outer and radial registers to name identical objects.
design.unit: Prospective only: all sixteen complete f69r outer items and all twenty-two complete radial items, with the twelve painted visual units, in each already admitted alternate reading of one manuscript. No item-to-source assignment or new target access in this proposal.
design.contrast: The specified Hildegard account of stellar reach and wind interaction versus the existing twelve-wind/sixteen-direction account or two independent lists. Distinct source entities alone do not establish the first account on the target.
design.prediction: Conditional on selecting this exact source account, one complete C0 writer must retain both (a) two stellar terminal classes, eight reaching thin air and eight only black fire, and (b) one solar-contact relation positive for three main heads and explicitly negative for bear. A fixed reusable relation with its endpoint or scope distinction must carry the clauses; sixteen unrelated name glosses do not suffice. The source allows shared list instructions rather than one negation token per item. These obligations do not apply to every generic wind or stellar hypothesis.
design.prior_blockers: GDT1081 supplies no authorial orientation or unique outer/radial owner relation; GDT1067 retains eight exact fits and polarity symmetry; FXR001 and FDC001 remain literal-root nonconfirmations. Lucca has a central human, animal heads and layered cosmos, whereas those owners are not established in f69r. No target syntax or lexeme currently carries either new relation. GDT1086 and SG1029/f67v2 topology stops are not reopened.
design.smallest_next_step: Author, before any scoring, one complete C0 allocation of all 38 already admitted items with a single stable reach/contact construction and explicit unknowns, preserving both selected source asymmetries. Hypothetical owners may be declared, not presented as observations. Stop if the complete allocation leaves both source relations freely relocatable; do not fill the gap by renaming each unknown group.
design.source_layer: Complete electronic Latin entry is not a diplomatic Lucca collation; full image supports separate animal and stellar objects, but all sixteen image endpoints have not been individually collated. Text at 752C repeats cervi in one inconsistent length clause and is retained unrepaired. §XXXV qualifies bodily affliction rather than excluding it universally.
design.scope: RAW exploratory authorship supply only. No target test, fixed mapping, new exposure, orientation choice, GDT388 packet, decoder, or publication claim.
